title: Rapid roadmap briefing: decision log, ask summary, and risk stitches
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a concise, one-page rapid briefing for the upcoming executive readout and board prep. Deliverables: (1) single-page summary of OKR progress and top 3 initiative health indicators; (2) decision log capturing recommended asks and decision points for the board; (3) an explicit risk stitches section connecting technical gaps to business impact and proposed mitigations; (4) a compact appendix with links to deep-dive artifacts (PRs, dashboards, design mocks). This ticket centralizes editorial ownership, collates inputs from ENG/Design/Research, and drives the final slide for the exec packet.

decision_log: Recommend board ask: contingency capacity fund capped at $200k for Dedicated burst capacity through Q3; conditional on engineering delivering autoscaler milestone v2 by 2025-06-30.
Do not recommend: immediate increase to dedicated reserved spend without engineering timeline; instead propose phased commit tied to performance KPIs.
Fallback policy: if autoscaler milestone slips beyond 2 weeks, trigger temporary routing to lower-cost model variants for non-SLA traffic (pre-approved).
risk_stitches: Serving runtime kernel mismatch at tail latencies -> customer-facing timeouts for low-latency plans -> mitigation: prioritize kernel selector hotfix (ENG-1842) and add circuit-breaker metric to console.
Autoscaler under-provisioning during coordinated traffic spikes -> SLA breach risk for Dedicated customers -> mitigation: contingency burst fund + canary traffic shaping rules.
Private deployment upgrade complexity -> delayed sales closes for regulated customers -> mitigation: dedicate 0.5 FTE for upgrade playbook and test matrix; track in release 'private-2025.1'.
